text:
alex: Heads-up — saw a short burst of ECC/Xid spikes in us-west-2 around 02:17 UTC. Prometheus fired 4 alerts in ~3m for nodes gpu-uw2-3 and gpu-uw2-7.

dina: saw that. DCGM exporter metrics showed a 60s spike in `dcgm_ecc_errors_total` then dropped back. smells like transient noise after the reclaim job. :thinking_face:

leo: can we avoid page fatigue? Current rule triggers on any non-zero increase in 1m which is too sensitive for short micro-spikes. proposal: debounce per-GPU, and only alert when +3 errors in 5m or sustained >0 for 4m.

alex: agreed. also want dedupe across cards on same node — don't open 4 incidents for 4 cards when it's a controller hiccup.

leo: draft rule snippet (for discussion):
```yaml
- alert: GPU_ECC_Error_Sustained
  expr: increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total{job="dcgm-exporter"}[5m]) > 3
  for: 4m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    ticket: cluster-ops
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained ECC errors on GPU ({{ $labels.instance }} / {{ $labels.gpu_index }})"
```

dina: looks reasonable. also add a recording rule to compute per-node aggregate so we can route to one alert per node: `sum by (instance) (increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[5m]))`

tia: for Xid errors we should treat differently — short Xid bursts often clear but persistent Xid5/13 needs action. propose Xid alert: `increase(dcgm_xid_errors_total[10m]) >= 1` with a longer `for: 10m` and a playbook link.

alex: playbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-health> — includes drain/replace thresholds. TL;DR: if node shows repeated ECC/Xid across >2 GPUs for >1h -> schedule drain and replacement.

leo: operational additions:
- add `for` to avoid 1m spikes
- suppress duplicate alerts using `group_key: "{{ $labels.instance }}"` in Alertmanager
- add silence window for known reclaim jobs (nightly)

infra-bot: nodes gpu-uw2-3,gpu-uw2-7 tagged with `gpu_health=flaky` by request from alex.

dina: can we add a Prometheus recording metric for per-gpu error-rate per-hour so Optimize can recommend binpacking away from unstable cards? that would help cost decisions.

alex: yes — `gpu_error_rate_hourly := increase(dcgm_ecc_errors_total[1h])` suggestion. Use that in fleet CSV exports.

prometheus-bot: alertmanager config test passed for the new rule; staging reload scheduled at 03:10 UTC.

tia: just a reminder — in us-west-2 we have constrained spare capacity this week (reserved capacity used up). if we start draining nodes we need to coordinate with capacity team to avoid throttling jobs. cc @capacity-team.

leo: noted. add `region: us-west-2` label to node-level alerts so capacity can filter. also add runbook step: before drain check `kubectl top node` to confirm job pressure.

alex: next steps: leo will open PR with rule + recording rule + alertmanager group_key change; tia will update runbook with the Xid thresholds and drain checklist; dina will add the recording metric export. I'll monitor staging reload and post results here. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks everyone. follow-ups in PR and runbook edits.

(reacted :eyes: by leo, :white_check_mark: by infra-bot)
